items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oscar was a difficult man for me although I played in his little band briefly.

ctx.x: Well again that’s considered one of your landmark records and I know lots of people who love the way that you and Warne played on that.

Some of it’s nice but just over all it was a feeling . . . of not being comfortable with anybody there, really. Not Oscar or Kenny. Kenny was always cool but Oscar was a difficult man for me although I played in his little band briefly.
